acquisition.sha256_semantics: SHA-256 of the member file (self-contained inner zip); integrity of the member content is additionally proven by the SPMD.zip central-directory CRC32 match

structure.field_delta_vs_documented: actual = documented 24 + RxDevice (column 1); no time fields beyond sender-side DSeconds

identity_and_time.bsmid_role: per-row record ID; NOT a cross-receiver message identity (0 multi-receiver BSMIDs)
identity_and_time.dseconds_semantics: sender-side milliseconds within minute (J2735 secMark-style; wraps)
identity_and_time.triple_key_coverage: partial (60,035,108 unique triples covered before memory cap; duplicates are a lower bound)

rx_device_namespace.interpretation: RxDevice uses the vehicle-device ID namespace (BsmP1Summary/DataWsuSummary), NOT the PCAPFile RSE LocID namespace; member name and handbook RSE-dataset description do not match the actual logger namespace; physical identity of the 2,008 loggers (onboard WSUs vs roadside units sharing the namespace) remains Ambiguous and requires the device inventory (e.g., BsmMd / UMTRI documentation) to resolve

holdout_and_scope.existing_split_rule: DeviceID|Trip hash (RV_RX calibration/holdout); not applicable to RSE_BSM (no DeviceID-Trip columns)
holdout_and_scope.analysis_performed: structural, identity and format integrity checks only
holdout_and_scope.analysis_deferred: all behavioral/distributional statistics pending researcher decision on isolation strategy

evidence_levels.message_source: Documented (TemporaryId rotating, MsgCount sequence; identity collisions make month-scale tracking Ambiguous)
evidence_levels.message_send: Not Observable (no absolute time; DSeconds is sender-side and wraps at 60 s)
evidence_levels.message_receive: Documented-structural (receive-event logging rows exist; receive time Not Observable)
evidence_levels.send_receive_pairing: Ambiguous (best in-member key (TemporaryId,MsgCount,DSeconds) has >=26.9M duplicates under partial coverage; no cross-receiver shared identity)
evidence_levels.latency: Not Observable (no receiver timestamp; no synchronized clocks documented)
evidence_levels.loss_and_delivery: Not Observable (no send base, no opportunity model, no time windows)
evidence_levels.environment_conditions: Potential (J2735 motion/position content; no channel/RSSI/power fields)

packet_decision_inputs.rse_bsm_time_anchor_via_packet: Not documented - Packet is PCAP/RSE-side (PCAPFile LocID namespace) while RSE_BSM loggers are in the vehicle-device namespace (0 overlap); a documented join key between Packet and RSE_BSM does not exist
packet_decision_inputs.packet_standalone_value: absolute GMT capture timestamps + PSID/channel/data-rate/power at 25 RSE sessions; resolves gate item packet_schema_evaluated
packet_decision_inputs.bsm_p1_revised_role: dictionary RxDevice+Gentime structure matches the RSE_BSM logger namespace; BsmP1 may provide receive-side absolute time for the same device population - value upgraded
